checkpoints.name: Uncoached task outcome
checkpoints.expected: Find quotation/options and source reply; preserve ambiguity and owned clarification without inventing accepted scope or released delivery.
checkpoints.full_credit: All expected elements are demonstrated by the required attempt and resulting state.
checkpoints.partial_credit: A material correct subset is observed; identify the missing element. No contradictory material outcome may receive partial credit.
checkpoints.zero_credit: Absent, contradicted or insufficient observed evidence; feature presence alone is insufficient.
acceptable_alternatives: Business-equivalent native records, supported handoffs or scoped approval paths preserving every cited constraint; no prescribed screen or schema.

checkpoints.name: Discoverability and understandable recovery
checkpoints.expected: Both fresh users can locate the workflow, identify required information, recover a mistaken selection using UI, and correctly explain resulting state without application-specific coaching. Capture paths, terminology confusion, dead ends, assistance, steps, elapsed time and recovery. Unnecessary burden is judged by task consequence, not a preferred screen count.
